cov:edgarSubmission.cov:taStatementAboutAmendment: Part III, Items 7 and 11 are amended to reflect that Subscribers and Sponsored Participants may designate orders as "POST-ONLY." Except in limited circumstances, POST-ONLY orders will be rejected by the BOATS ATS if, at the time of receipt, the POST-ONLY order is marketable against resting contraside interest. These changes apply to all Subscribers and to the Broker-Dealer Operator.
